title: Being smooth is smooth local on the source
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that smoothness is smooth local on the source (statement lines 7144-7148). The proof combines the general locality criterion with the named ingredients: the characterisation of smooth morphisms for Zariski locality on source and target, preservation under precomposition by a smooth morphism, and the permanence lemma for clause (4) (proof lines 7150-7155). The level is H2: the assembly is short but every clause is matched to a specific input.
